method: Compared every atlas cell against the baseline commit and each new quiet cell against the approved source PNG; visually inspected both ordered six-cell rows plus the frame 5 to frame 0 closure in circular-contact-sheet.png at native cell size. No live desktop playback claimed.

visual_review.direction: Up -> right -> down-right -> down -> left -> up-left -> up. Face yaw, gaze and head pitch follow the intended clockwise order.
visual_review.hands: Both hands remain visible with relaxed arms throughout the six-pose sequence; no original behind-back quiet poses remain.
visual_review.identity: Approved head, hair, goggles, outfit and body proportions preserved because the source pose pixels are copied exactly.
visual_review.registration: Boots remain planted. No clipping or cell-edge contact observed; the six cells keep transparent margins.
visual_review.wrap: Frame 5 up-left returns to frame 0 up with a 45-degree gaze step. Both states share the same source sequence; the idle hold is calmer and thinking cadence quicker.
visual_review.appeal: Warm open-eyed upward expression, curious right/left turns and lowered thoughtful gaze form a small head roll.

limitations: Six native cells cannot reproduce sixteen-pose smoothness: the up-to-right and down-to-left transitions each cover 90 degrees.
Ordered still-frame review and exact pixel checks do not certify subjective live desktop animation smoothness.
App-controlled timings cannot match the full 16-pose reference loops; non-loop actions may return to idle after three cycles.
